description: This is a Python source file that implements a voice-enabled chat bot with speech recognition, text-to-speech, language modeling, and transport setup. It defines a main async function to run a bot with configurable transports and connects various services such as speech recognition, text-to-speech, and language models. The file also sets up event handlers for client connections and disconnections.
